## Community Coordinated Modeling Center Database Of Notifications, Knowledge, Information ( CCMC DONKI )
## Message Type: Space Weather Notification - CMEs update (Mars, OSIRIS-APEX, Parker Solar Probe, Solar Orbiter)
##
## Message Issue Date: 2024-05-17T18:22:15Z
## Message ID: 20240517-AL-004
##
## Disclaimer: NOAA's Space Weather Prediction Center is the United States Government official source for space weather forecasts. This "Experimental Research Information" consists of preliminary NASA research products and should be interpreted and used accordingly.


## Summary:

Update on CME with ID 2024-05-17T12:48:00-CME-001.  Based on preliminary analysis by the Moon to Mars Space Weather Analysis Office and heliospheric modeling carried out at NASA Community Coordinated Modeling Center, it is likely that this CME  would combine with preceding two CMEs and it is estimated that the combined front of these three CMEs may impact Mars, OSIRIS-APEX, Parker Solar Probe, and Solar Orbiter.  The leading edge of the CME will reach Mars at 2024-05-20T07:52Z, OSIRIS-APEX at 2024-05-19T09:31Z, Parker Solar Probe at 2024-05-19T00:37Z, and Solar Orbiter at 2024-05-18T21:55Z (plus minus 7 hours). 


CME parameters are:

1. Start time of the event: 2024-05-17T00:12Z.

Estimated speed: ~679 km/s.

Estimated opening half-angle: 20 deg.

Direction (lon./lat.): 128/-7 in Heliocentric Earth Equatorial coordinates.

Activity ID: 2024-05-17T00:12:00-CME-001


2: Start time of the event: 2024-05-17T04:17Z.

Estimated speed: ~586 km/s.

Estimated opening half-angle: 17 deg.

Direction (lon./lat.): 130/-4 in Heliocentric Earth Equatorial coordinates.

Activity ID: 2024-05-17T04:17:00-CME-001


3: Parameters for this CME have not been updated.

Start time of the event: 2024-05-17T12:48Z.

Estimated speed: ~1134 km/s.

Estimated opening half-angle: 44 deg.

Direction (lon./lat.): 136/3 in Heliocentric Earth Equatorial coordinates.

Activity ID: 2024-05-17T12:48:00-CME-001
